scope: Outdoor palace envelope of Palazzo del Bo, the Old and New Courtyards and the six-tier anatomical theatre associated with the Old Court wing, in its preserved early twenty-first-century form.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Identifies the palace’s two principal courts and the wing adjoining the Old Court that holds the theatre.
Dates the Old Court and the work of Andrea Moroni. The entablature and arms are enduring architectural details.
Establishes the six timber tiers of the historic theatre, with widths changing from 2.97 m to 7.56 m.
Corroborates the sixteenth-century wing, two tiers of court arcades and the early twentieth-century New Court.
University archival exhibit describes the old tower, medieval houses and 1930s competition including the historic façade portico.
Public cultural record identifies the 1932 expansion and its designers.
University archival article dates and describes the shortening of Torre del Bo in 1914, and its historic bell and clock.
